scope: The actual nonlinear annulus inner DN derivative in its complete physical trace units and the updated continuous scalar Darboux-source Jacobi column; the mixed-tail relative graph inverse and general metric-source conversion are not asserted.

inputs.source_units: e = delta K_t - D F_t[delta P,delta K,delta U,delta V]

checks.name: actual_inner_half_kernel_margin
checks.evidence: M>=4, with q_i=exp(t/2) and the actual paid angle ramp

checks.name: inner_weighted_green_height
checks.evidence: Both exact finite-interval half-kernels are retained

checks.name: inner_weighted_green_first_jet
checks.evidence: Use the complete differentiated Green kernel

checks.name: inner_weighted_green_second_jet
checks.evidence: The second derivative is recovered from the exact ODE

checks.name: inner_weighted_complete_green
checks.evidence: All three jets are summed before all Fourier frequencies

checks.name: unweighted_variable_angle_margin
checks.evidence: The W0 inward kernel rate is at least M/4

checks.name: W0_green_height
checks.evidence: Two half-kernels with rates M and M/4

checks.name: W0_green_first_jet
checks.evidence: The exact first kernel derivative

checks.name: W0_green_second_jet
checks.evidence: Use the exact Jacobi ODE

checks.name: W0_complete_green
checks.evidence: Same actual long interval and variable angle strip

checks.name: inner_Jacobi_contraction
checks.evidence: Actual h=h0+z has complete W0 norm less than 2r

checks.name: inner_Jacobi_boundary_bound
checks.evidence: This is the full nonlinear DN derivative input column

checks.name: true_outer_state_difference
checks.evidence: All four states, including the complete mean-root difference

checks.name: true_inner_state_derivative
checks.evidence: The complete mean derivative is included in D S(h) xi

checks.name: background_split_source_fee
checks.evidence: q_i q_o=exp(L/2), so the separated product pays exp(-L/2) exactly

checks.name: inner_endpoint_source_fee
checks.evidence: M times the inner derivative kernel integrates at rate at least M/4

checks.name: actual_updated_DN_difference_fee
checks.evidence: This is a relative operator norm on actual inner boundary traces

checks.name: actual_long_length_exceeds_screening_budget
checks.evidence: Using e>2 gives r exp(-L/2)<2^-8418=r0

checks.name: relative_DN_actual_number
checks.evidence: The real all-frequency updated DN difference is below the stated safe bound

checks.name: actual_mean_boundary_derivative_fee
checks.evidence: The full holonomy-root derivative from N.12 is retained

checks.name: actual_mean_boundary_number
checks.evidence: The inner normalized mean slope derivative is not discarded

checks.name: source_holonomy_decay_rate
checks.evidence: (w^2)_t=2w^2 on the same A=1 radial annulus

checks.name: source_holonomy_integral_constant
checks.evidence: ||rho A_h||<2 and the e^-2(t-s) kernel has L1 norm at most 1/2

checks.name: mean_load_to_nonmean_source
checks.evidence: b_h=Pi_perp(partial_K Q_full)/<rho A_h>, with N<8r

checks.name: updated_continuous_source_Green
checks.evidence: The actual updated inverse is the complete W0 Neumann inverse

checks.name: updated_continuous_source_E_constant
checks.evidence: Includes the source-induced mean load before solving the nonmean equation

checks.name: updated_source_initial_mean_constant
checks.evidence: The actual initial source holonomy m_B is a retained input

checks.name: updated_source_boundary_constant
checks.evidence: Both actual nonmean Dirichlet endpoints are retained
